view.stem: Two complete straight lines AC and BD are to intersect at O, with OC opposite OA and angle AOB = 155 degrees. Choose the valid construction plan and record of the other three angles, listed in the order BOC, COD, DOA.

options.text: Draw line AC through O and ray OB so that angle AOB is 155 degrees. Extend OB through O to the opposite ray OD, making line BD. Other angles: (25 degrees, 155 degrees, 25 degrees).
Draw line AC through O and ray OB so that angle AOB is 155 degrees. Extend OB through O to the opposite ray OD, making line BD. Other angles: (155 degrees, 25 degrees, 155 degrees).
Draw line AC through O and ray OB so that angle AOB is 155 degrees. Place D on the same ray as B from O, taking rays OB and OD as line BD. Other angles: (25 degrees, 25 degrees, 155 degrees).
Draw line AC through O and ray OB so that angle AOB is 155 degrees. Extend OB through O to the opposite ray OD, making line BD. Other angles: (68 1/3 degrees, 68 1/3 degrees, 68 1/3 degrees).
